kan_identity_inversion.assumption: the KAN's two slack responses take the lowest |dhat| ranks with no other ties or zero responses (true exactly for EBM, SP and tie-free XGB scenarios; within 2.1e-3 for FTT and linear, whose slack responses are float noise); an estimate, not a measurement

KAN_row.reason: r16_kan_faith.py stores per-scenario summaries only (r16_kan_faith_rows.csv); no per-probe KAN responses dhat were written, so the slack-excluded KAN rho needs a KAN refit and probe-matrix evaluation (a model run).

displayed_contribution_ordering_0.01.reason: r19_disp.py stores per-scenario rho only; the per-feature displayed EBM contributions at the base point were not written, so the slack-excluded value needs an EBM refit and eval_terms (a model run).
